answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the yarrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
